findings.detail: A07 aggregate pct_sum is 0.0 even though the source fair value percentage schedules total 100.00 percent for December 31, 2023.

rationale: The raw filing source is readable and contradicts the flagged aggregate. The review artifact reports A07 pct_sum=0.0%, but the December 31, 2023 fair value summary totals to 100.00% of total investments and 142.52% of net assets, with an industry fair value schedule also totaling 100.00%. This indicates the pipeline missed or failed to map the source percentage totals rather than a true zero-percent portfolio.

culprit_citations.quoted_text: Fair Value total for December 31, 2023 reports Total | $ | 2,857,808 | 100.00 | % | 142.52 | %
Industry fair value schedule reports Total | 100.00 | % for December 31, 2023
